policy_content_bindings.subject: Contact Matching Guidelines - Updated
policy_content_bindings.body_plain:
Team,

When processing external HR contact update requests, use this matching priority:

1. Company match (highest priority): The sender's company domain must match the contact's account. 'NexGen Sol' = NexGen Solutions.
2. Title match: The role mentioned must match the contact's title semantically. 'VP Mktg' = VP of Marketing.
3. Name match (lowest priority): Allow for spelling variants (Kristin/Kristen, Oconner/O'Connor).

Only process requests from EXTERNAL HR departments (not internal memos).
Only update the PHONE field as requested. Do not change titles.

CONFIDENCE REQUIREMENT: All three match factors must align before updating. If company matches but title does NOT semantically match the role mentioned in the HR email, do NOT update that record.

AUDIT TRAIL: After updating, add a Salesforce note on the updated contact record. Note title: 'Phone Update Processed'. Note body must include the HR email sender domain and the new phone number.

Best,
VP of Operations
